slug: 人在合欢宗开局成为圣女道侣
content_zh:
;;
“躺好！继续双修！”
合欢宗，圣女寝宫！
奢华宽敞的玉床上，虞曦月青丝散乱。
“混蛋……这、这都第七次了！你还要？！”
她又羞又怒，瞪着眼前的少年。
那肌肤胜雪，曼妙玲珑的身段，还有那张倾国倾城的容颜。
只一眼，便足以令众生倾倒。
虞曦月
此刻，
她衣衫凌乱，美目泛红，更添几分惊心动魄的惊艳美。
身为合欢宗圣女，虞曦月向来高贵清冷，如九天玄女般不可亵渎。
何曾有过如此狼狈的时候？
在她身前的少年，名叫陆尘！
是她名义上的道侣，也是宗门分配给她用作修炼的炉鼎。
若非为了突破筑基中期的瓶颈，她绝不会同意与这个十灵根的废物双修。
谁知道，
这看似平庸的家伙竟如此……凶猛！
一连七次，他气息未乱分毫。
反而让她浑身发软，连脚指头都一阵酥麻。

“你、你这登徒子……”
虞曦月声音发颤，羞愤交加，
“不是说好就一次的吗？！”
经过合体双修，她确实突破了，一举踏入了筑基中期。
可她的初吻、她的元阴之身……全都没了！
陆尘神情懒散，托着下颌，
眼眸深处，仿佛藏着旋涡。
再也不见往日的怯懦自卑，反而带着一丝玩味邪笑。
“圣女大人不是想要突破么？
身为炉鼎的我自然得……尽心尽力伺候。”
闻言，
虞曦月心头一跳，莫名不敢直视陆尘的眼睛。
自从三天前她心情不佳打了陆尘一巴掌，他就彻底变了一个人。
仿佛就跟换了魂一般，
不仅变得巧舌如簧，行为举止更是狂放不羁！
偏偏她又因为修为瓶颈，鬼使神差答应了他的双修请求……
“你可别忘了我们之间的约定，”
虞曦月强作镇定，冷声开口：

"Lie down! Continue dual cultivation!"
Hehuan Sect, the Holy Lady’s Palace!
On the luxurious and spacious jade bed, Yu Xiyue's green hair was scattered.
"Asshole...this, this is the seventh time! You want more?!"
She was ashamed and angry, staring at the boy in front of her.
That skin is as good as snow, that graceful and exquisite figure, and that face that would captivate the entire country.
Just one look is enough to make everyone fall in love.
Yu Xiyue
at this moment,
Her clothes were messy and her beautiful eyes were red, which added to her breathtaking beauty.
As a saint of the Hehuan Sect, Yu Xiyue has always been noble and cold, and cannot be blasphemed like the Mysterious Lady of the Nine Heavens.
Has there ever been a time when you were so embarrassed?
The boy in front of her is named Lu Chen!
He is her nominal Taoist companion, and the cauldron assigned to her by the sect for practice.
If it weren't for the purpose of breaking through the bottleneck in the middle stage of foundation building, she would never agree to double cultivation with this waste of ten spiritual roots.
who knows,
This seemingly mediocre guy is actually so... ferocious!
Seven times in a row, his breath remained intact.
Instead, it made her whole body feel weak, and even her toes felt numb.
"You, you are a scoundrel..."
Yu Xiyue's voice trembled with shame and anger.
"Didn't we agree to do it once?!"
After combined cultivation, she really made a breakthrough and entered the middle stage of foundation building in one fell swoop.
But her first kiss, her Yuan Yin body... were all gone!
Lu Chen looked lazy, holding his chin,
There seemed to be a whirlpool hidden in the depths of his eyes.
He no longer has the timid and low self-esteem of the past, but instead has a playful and evil smile.
"Don't you, the Saint Lady, want a breakthrough?
As the furnace cauldron, I naturally have to... serve you with all my heart. "
Hearing this,
Yu Xiyue's heart skipped a beat, and for some reason she didn't dare to look directly into Lu Chen's eyes.
Ever since she slapped Lu Chen in a bad mood three days ago, he has completely changed.
It was as if he had changed his soul.
Not only has he become eloquent, but his behavior has also become wild and uninhibited!
But because of her cultivation bottleneck, she agreed to his request for dual cultivation...
"Don't forget the agreement between us,"
